description: Get recent events recorded by the base station — arm/disarm, sensor opens, lock and unlock, alarms, errors — newest first. Each event carries an ISO timestamp alongside the raw epoch seconds.

event_type.description: Only return events with this eventType, e.g. "activity" or "alarm".

from_timestamp.description: Only events at or after this Unix timestamp (seconds).

num_events.description: How many events to return, 1-50 (SimpliSafe rejects more than 50). Defaults to 50.

sid.description: System id. Optional when the account has exactly one system; required when it has several.

name: simplisafe_get_events
